elo.formula: m = w_surf * R_surface + (1 - w_surf) * R_all; P(1) = 1 / (1 + 10^(-f (m1 - m2) / 400)), f = bo5 for best of five, else 1 (ratings: elo.json current)

blend.formula: logit p = w_elo logit(elo_p) + w_sr logit(sr_p); sr_p = chain(p_srv1, p_srv2); the serve-point pair is then shifted (p1 + d, p2 - d) until the chain returns p

serve_return.formula: logit hold(i v j) = mu + clay|grass + indoor + bo5 + level[lv] + (s_i + ds_i,surface) - (r_j + dr_j,surface); unknown players s = new_s, r = new_r; p_srv = inverse of G(p) = p^4 (1 + 4q + 10q^2) + 20 p^3 q^3 p^2 / (1 - 2pq); displayed hold adds k_hold, displayed SPW = sigmoid(logit p + k_spw). Player s, r per surface: the latest 'serve_return' row per surface in the career file.
